board_model: NM-xxxxx (placeholder; verify against the actual board)
symptoms: no LED when adapter plugged in
initial_observations: Adapter LED on the tip lights when plugged into the jack (adapter is good).
No LED on the laptop when adapter plugged in.
diagnostic_path: Resistance check: +3VALW reads 4.7 ohm to ground (hard short).
Current-limited bench supply at 3.3 V, 0.5 A: C123 (output bulk cap on +3VALW) heats up.
Removed C123, re-measured +3VALW resistance: 1.2 kohm (short cleared).
Replaced C123 with same value/voltage/temp-rated cap.
root_cause: C123 shorted internally, dragging +3VALW to ground. The standby controller could not start; the board never reached S5.
repair_action: Replaced C123 with same value/voltage/temp-rated capacitor.
final_verification: Board boots to OS; +3VALW stable at 3.30 V under load; battery charges.
technician_notes: Classic standby-rail short. The +5VALW resistance was normal, localising the short to the +3VALW domain. Thermal scan under current-limited injection identified C123 within seconds.
promotion_notes: Verified by second technician; re-test passed. Promoted to reusable knowledge.
